purpose: The files of the Contexa core whose content can change what the guard decides for a tool call. The hash of exactly these files (freeze_release.py) is the 'decision path hash' of the plan, section 4.1: if it is the same, other changes of the core (screens, console, documents) do not make a result invalid; if it differs, the result belongs to a new release.
note: Main sources only; tests are not part of the decision path. The list is part of the freeze file, so a change of this list is visible.
